title: File names you can tell apart, small screens that fit

items.text: Long file names keep the part that tells them apart, like Vol 1 and Vol 2, wherever files are listed.
A video file shows a film icon, so a clip reads as a video before you open it.
Pop-ups, file cards and tabs fit small windows and stay in view as you move with the keyboard.
On iPhone and Android, voice control reaches more buttons by the words they show.
